entities.name: Rift Era
entities.description: A period from about 4206 to 4500 AR of escalating magical instability across the multiverse, marked by time and space rifts on Dominaria and ending with the Great Mending.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The central stage of the Rift Era, where time and space rifts formed.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A war that had ended before the Rift Era began.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane created by Karn during the Rift Era, originally called Argentum.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where magical instability culminated in Dissension.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A part of Dominaria where the Mirari caused chaos.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact that amplified magic, desire and ambition on Otaria.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: A conflict over the Mirari that ended with it in Kamahl's hands.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: A conflict over the Mirari on Otaria.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Gained the Mirari; his actions inadvertently led to the Rebirth of Karona.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A godlike being personifying the plane's mana, whose existence unbalanced Dominaria's magic; her brief reign ended in her destruction.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: A war that triggered a final time rift formation across Otaria.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who used the Mirari's core to create Memnarch, and who sacrificed himself to close the rifts.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A golem created by Karn to protect Argentum, corrupted by glistening oil into madness.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: Substance carried unknowingly from Dominaria that corrupted Memnarch.

entities.name: Corruption of Memnarch
entities.description: The event in which Memnarch was driven to supreme madness.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: The event leading Glissa and Slobad to defeat Memnarch.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Defeated Memnarch with Slobad.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Defeated Memnarch with Glissa.

entities.name: Mirrodin's Core
entities.description: Where Memnarch was defeated.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event that drained Mirrodin of much of its life forms.

entities.name: Schism
entities.description: A Ravnican event during the Rift Era.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The 10,000-year anniversary of the Signing of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The Ravnican pact whose signing was celebrated at the Decamillennial and later broken.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: Large-scale havoc on Ravnica caused by Momir Vig, Izolda, Szadek and the Nephilim.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A figure whose machinations contributed to the Dissension.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: A figure whose machinations contributed to the Dissension.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A figure whose machinations contributed to the Dissension.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Beings involved in the Dissension.

entities.name: Temporal Crisis of Dominaria
entities.description: The culmination of the Rift Era, in which time rifts widened across Dominaria until sealed at great cost, triggering the Great Mending.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A legendary planeswalker who sacrificed his spark or life to close the rifts.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A legendary planeswalker who sacrificed her spark or life to close the rifts.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A legendary planeswalker who sacrificed his spark or life to close the rifts.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A planeswalker whose final sacrifice closed the last rift.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker who reemerged and manipulated the chaos, sacrificing Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Sacrificed by Nicol Bolas to seal the rift over Madara.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A region of Dominaria where a time rift opened.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The multiversal event catalyzed by Jeska's sacrifice, after which planeswalkers were mortal mages.

entities.name: Mending Era
entities.description: The era of rebuilding that began after the Great Mending.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker of the new generation after the Mending.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker of the new generation after the Mending.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker of the new generation after the Mending.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker of the new generation after the Mending.

events.summary: The Mirari falls into Kamahl's hands, and his actions inadvertently lead to the Rebirth of Karona.
events.quote: saw it eventually falling into the hands of Kamahl , whose actions inadvertently led to the Rebirth of Karona

events.summary: Karona's War triggers a final time rift formation across Otaria, and her brief reign ends in her destruction.
events.quote: Her brief, unstable reign ended in her destruction, but the damage to the plane's leylines was done.

events.summary: Karn uses the Mirari's core to create Memnarch, protector of the artificial plane of Argentum.
events.quote: the planeswalker Karn used the Mirari’s core to create Memnarch

events.summary: Glistening oil corrupts Memnarch, who abducts organic beings from other planes to seed Mirrodin.
events.quote: he began abducting organic beings from other planes to seed life on Mirrodin

events.summary: Glissa and Slobad defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core, triggering the Vanishing.
events.quote: The Fifth Dawn event would lead Glissa and Slobad to defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core

events.summary: On Ravnica the Guildpact is broken and the Dissension unfolds.
events.quote: The subsequent breaking of the Guildpact and the events of the Dissension

events.summary: Time rifts widen across Dominaria, draining mana and warping the multiverse.
events.quote: mana drained from the plane and the multiverse began to warp

events.summary: Legendary planeswalkers sacrifice their sparks or lives to close the rifts.
events.quote: to sacrifice their sparks or lives to close the rifts

events.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara.
events.quote: sacrificing Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara

events.summary: Jeska's final sacrifice closes the last rift, catalyzing the Great Mending; planeswalkers become mortal mages.
events.quote: Jeska’s final sacrifice closed the last rift, catalyzing the multiversal Great Mending .
